observations: Photo shows a black vintage treadle sewing machine mounted on a cast-iron stand with a flat wooden/metal plate table.
Treadle wheel and pedal mechanism visible at the base.
No visible brand name, logo, or model plate is legible on the machine head in the photo.
Watermark text 'POSTED ON JIJI' and a username overlay the image, not a manufacturer mark.
Surface shows typical wear (scuffed paint, some rust tone) consistent with age, but no close-up of mechanism or needle area.

claims.evidence: No 'Singer' brand marking or plate is readable in photo 0; claim cannot be confirmed from the image alone.
No video or demonstration of stitching/motion; a static photo cannot show mechanical function.
Photo 0 shows a flat plate table attached to the stand.

claims.claim: complete set (implying additional unseen parts, e.g. drawer, accessories)
claims.evidence: Only one photo provided; no view of accessory box, drawer, or additional components mentioned by '...' in listing.

risks.risk: Mechanical function of the head (needle bar, bobbin, tension) may be seized or broken despite claim of working perfectly.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the treadle being pedaled and the needle moving, or a close-up of the needle area in motion.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories implied by 'complete set' (e.g., bobbins, belt, drawer, manual).
risks.proof: Additional photos showing the underside, drawer, and accessory tray.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, without accessories

risks.risk: Structural integrity of the cast-iron stand and treadle linkage (cracks, rust, wobble) not visible from a single frontal shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the treadle joints, wheel, and legs from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming moderate wear, no premium for 'excellent' condition

risks.risk: Unverifiable brand identity (claimed Singer) could affect resale value if not an authentic Singer unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the Singer badge, serial number plate, or decal on the machine head or arm.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded treadle machine

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any brand plate, badge, or serial number on the machine head.
Short video of the treadle being operated and the needle moving to demonstrate 'working perfectly'.
Photos of the underside, drawer, and any accessories included in the 'complete set'.
Multiple angle shots of the stand and treadle linkage to assess rust or structural damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a treadle sewing machine by type, and though brand and working condition are unverified, a worst-case price (as unbranded, unconfirmed working) can still be set from the single photo provided.
